canon.note: Sawblade Tuning (100301, Basic): single-target, dealt in 2 hits (40% + 60% per notes). Molten Detonation (100302, Skill): primary target dealt in 7 hits (20/20/5/5/5/5/40), adjacent in 3 hits (20/20/60). Heavenly Flare (100303, Ultimate): AoE, +Energy per enemy defeated. Victory Rush (100304, Talent): on Weakness Break gain Charge (Elite+ = 3 per notes); at full Charge, any ally attack triggers 1 Follow-Up ATK vs all enemies, consuming all Charge, dealt in 4 hits (20/20/20/40 per notes); start of battle = 1 Charge. Starfire (Trace): 50% base chance to inflict Burn on attack (2 turns), Burn DoT = 30% ATK at start of turn. Magma (Trace): Skill deals +20% DMG to Burned enemies. Benchmark (Trace): CRIT Rate +15% at HP >= 80%.

fixtures.env: Himeko E0 solo vs 3 Fire-weak Elite dummies (Lv120, 6M HP, 40 Toughness), 3 cycles, seed 7 — low Toughness so Weakness Breaks and Victory Rush fire

requirements.claim: Heavenly Flare (100303) is Himeko's Ultimate action (1 cast in the fixture).
Molten Detonation (100302) is her Skill action (4 casts in the fixture).
Sawblade Tuning (100301) is her Basic ATK action (2 casts in the fixture).
Molten Detonation primary-target damage: 14 events (2 plain casts x 7 hits, canon 100302 20/20/5/5/5/5/40).
When the primary target is Burned, the Magma label variant fires 7 hits per cast: 14 events (2 casts).
Molten Detonation adjacent plain damage: 6 events (canon 100302 3-hit 20/20/60 split).
Molten Detonation adjacent Burn label variant: 18 events (3-hit split per adjacent enemy).
Heavenly Flare (100303) is AoE: 3 damage events (1 per enemy) in the fixture.
Victory Rush (100304) Follow-Up ATK fires 3 times in the fixture; each is the canon 4-hit split vs all 3 enemies -> 36 damage events.
Sawblade Tuning (100301) hits twice per cast (40% + 60% per notes) — 2 casts x 2 hits = 4 events.
4 Weakness Breaks occur in the fixture (toughness 40 dummies; each Elite broken once, first Elite twice).
Starfire (Trace) applies Burn 10 times in the fixture (50% base chance per attack).
The Basic ATK regenerates 1 Skill Point per cast (2 casts = 2 SP).
The Skill costs 1 Skill Point per cast (4 casts = 4 SP).
Molten Detonation L10 (100302) primary total 200% of ATK over the 20/20/5/5/5/5/40 split; last (40%) piece = 0.8.
Molten Detonation with Magma (+20% Skill DMG vs Burned enemies) = 220% of ATK; last 40% piece = 0.88.
Molten Detonation L10 (100302) adjacent total 80% of ATK over the 20/20/60 split; last (60%) piece = 0.48.
Adjacent Magma bonus: 80% + 20% = 100% of ATK; last 60% piece = 0.6.
Heavenly Flare L10 (100303) AoE multiplier is 230% of ATK.
Victory Rush L10 (100304) total 140% of ATK over its canon 4-hit split (20% piece = 0.28).
Victory Rush final piece carries the canon 40% = 0.56.
Sawblade Tuning first hit = 40% of the L6 100% basic -> 0.4.
Sawblade Tuning second hit = 60% -> 0.6.
Over the fixture Himeko gains exactly 180 Energy (ENERGY_GAIN sum; Ultimate consumes 130).
Benchmark (Trace: CRIT Rate +15% at HP >= 80%) is active as a buff in the fixture.
Victory Rush needs Charge from Weakness Break: the first Weakness Break resolves before the last Follow-Up ATK.
